name: 30° Dive CCIP
summary: Roll in from 8,000 ft, 30° dive, pickle at 4,500 ft
procedure: A-G master mode, CCIP selected, correct station and ripple settings
Roll in, put the pipper short of the target and let it walk up
Pickle at release altitude — 4 G recovery, jink on egress
source: community practice (Chuck's Guide F-16C, 476th vFG battle book pattern)

name: 45° Dive CCIP (HAHD)
procedure: A-G master mode, CCIP selected
Steep roll-in — expect rapid speed build, throttle back as needed
Pickle at release altitude — 5 G recovery, do not press

name: DTOS 20°
summary: Designate in a shallow dive, pull, computer releases — good over terrain
procedure: A-G master mode, DTOS selected
In the dive: TD box on the target, TMS forward to designate
Pickle and hold, pull to the release cue — the jet releases

name: Low-angle laydown 10° (HD)
summary: Shallow, fast and low with high-drag bombs
procedure: High-drag / retarded bombs only — low-drag bombs will frag you
A-G master mode, CCIP selected
Pipper on, pickle at release altitude, stay low on egress

name: Pop-up 4 nm
summary: Low run-in, pop at 4 nm to a 7,500 ft apex, 20° dive
procedure: A-G master mode, CCIP selected before the IP
At the pop: pull, MAX power, check the apex altitude
Roll in, pipper on, pickle at release altitude
source: validated in-app test profile (4 nm / 7,500 ft apex / 20°), release numbers estimated

name: Level CCRP 15k (LGB)
summary: Straight and level, TGP lase, system release
procedure: A-G master mode, CCRP; TGP SOI, point track the target
Wings level, pickle and hold — jet releases at the cue
Lase from 8–10 s before impact until impact

name: Level CCRP 20k (JDAM)
summary: Straight and level inside the LAR, system release
procedure: A-G master mode, CCRP; steerpoint or TGP-designated target
Inside the LAR: wings level, pickle and hold until release

name: Laydown 500 ft (HD)
summary: Fast and low, level release of high-drag bombs
procedure: High-drag / retarded bombs only
A-G master mode, CCRP, target designated
Level at 500 ft, pickle and hold through release

name: Maverick 8k level
summary: Medium altitude, lock and fire inside range
procedure: A-G master mode, Maverick selected, seeker uncaged
Slew to the target, lock, confirm in range
Fire — keep the nose on until launch

name: Loft 30°
summary: Low ingress, 30° pull at 4 nm, computed release
procedure: A-G master mode, CCRP, target designated
At the pull-up cue: 4 G to 30° nose up, pickle and hold
Jet releases on the cue — roll and dive away, stay low
